about: SubagentStop usage collector: where the native hook is stricter than the Node oracle about which transcript it reads.
ruling: Reviewer batch 3 N9 (20261012-013345-17oj), accepted by the Orchestrator
node: hooks/subagentstop-usage.mjs joins the payload's session_id and agent_id into <project dir>/<session_id>/subagents/agent-<agent_id>.jsonl without checking either, so an id carrying a separator or .. sums a transcript outside the session's own subagents folder
native: Ah.Hooks SubagentStopUsage reads a transcript only when session_id and agent_id are each one path component (no '/', no NUL, not '.' or '..'); otherwise the usage row is still appended, found false with zero sums
reason: the read is sum-only and nothing but token counts reaches the log, but the path is built from payload data; Claude's ids are uuid or hex tokens, so refusing a separator costs no real input

rowsExercisingNode.node: found true, sums of the sibling session's transcript

nativeOnly.proves: session_id ../x, session_id .. and an agent_id climbing out through x/../../../y are not followed
an id that only contains dots (a..b, sess.v1..2) is one component and is read
